Thirteenth closed beta of Verso.

## Dark mode

- Read in dark mode. Turn it on from the top drawer or in Settings under
  Display.
- Covers and book pictures are not inverted, and colored text is adjusted to
  stay readable.
- Choose Fewer flashes, Balanced or Less ghosting, or set each refresh option
  yourself.

## Fixes

- Pictures in books are no longer enlarged to two or three times their size,
  and resized pictures look smoother.
- Pages that hold only a picture now refresh as picture pages.
- Fixed damaged layout caches, which could make a book take a few seconds
  longer to open.
- On older Kindles such as Paperwhite 4, dragging a slider no longer leaves
  dots behind, and book text no longer shows through dark buttons and menus.
- On Colorsoft, Wi-Fi transfer shows its network name again, not only the IP
  address.
- On 6-inch Kindles, the Wi-Fi transfer screen no longer draws text over the
  QR code.
